purpose: Raster provenance for the Tagrove introduction page under site/. Every image the page ships is listed with where it came from.
honestyRule: Interface screenshots are real application output. Reference material (the photographs and documents pinned on the wall) is synthetic. The page states this distinction in its footer.

realInterface.how: Real English desktop app, captured through the existing project QA interface with an isolated synthetic library. Run node site/scripts/capture-english.cjs from the repository root, or node scripts/capture-english.cjs from site/. Then run python site/scripts/encode-demos.py. Interface text and document content are rendered by the actual app; screenshot text is not painted over or replaced.
realInterface.build: 0.6.13 test build, confirmed as the standing baseline for this page on 2026-10-19. Downloads still point at the 0.6.12 stable release; re-run the capture script after installing a new build.

realInterface.legacyAssets: Unsuffixed Chinese screenshots remain as historical source assets; the English page does not reference them.

syntheticMaterial.how: AI-generated stand-ins for a visitor's own reference material, produced with the Qoder Desktop image tool and re-encoded with Pillow (JPEG q84-88). They are not Tagrove users' files and not real project records. The same set is imported by qa/make-landing-material.py to drive the captures above.

fonts.how: Self-hosted woff2 subsets fetched from Google Fonts on 2026-10-19 and committed under assets/fonts/. The page declares Inter in its stack but never loaded it, so every Latin run rendered in the platform fallback; these files close that gap.
fonts.cjk: Chinese text stays on the native face (Microsoft YaHei UI / PingFang SC). No CJK webfont ships: the audience is Windows and a full family is tens of megabytes.

assets.fonts/inter-latin-var.woff2: Inter, variable weight 400-700, latin subset, 48 KB. SIL Open Font License.
assets.fonts/instrument-serif-latin.woff2: Instrument Serif, roman, latin subset, 21 KB. Carries the English gloss voice. SIL Open Font License.
assets.fonts/instrument-serif-latin-italic.woff: Instrument Serif, italic, latin subset, 22 KB. Carries the headline tagline. SIL Open Font License.

engineNote: The Impeccable engine could not be installed earlier on this host: its binary is fetched from a github.com release URL, which timed out there, and the partial download was removed so a later launcher run re-fetches cleanly instead of executing a truncated file. Provenance was therefore recorded in this file rather than embedded in each image. On 2026-10-19 the launcher did bootstrap successfully through this machine's local proxy (127.0.0.1:7890), so impeccable context and detect now run.
workflowIllustration: The browser capture section is native HTML with English labels. It is explicitly a workflow illustration, because the shipping browser extension is Chinese-only.
motion: Actual English app compositor recordings at continuous frame timestamps, encoded to 30 fps H.264 MP4 for inline hover playback. GIF exports are regenerated at 20 fps. A presentation pointer follows the recorded mouse events. The transparent floating window is flattened onto a paper backdrop for encoding. Mouse entry starts from zero; leaving, page refresh/history restore, hidden tabs and offscreen playback restore the still poster and reset time. Reduced-motion users opt in using the button; touch and keyboard have the same button alternative. Playback state is not persisted.

languages.switching: Native language links preserve the current section hash. Each page references its own localized static screenshots, 30 fps MP4 recordings, and demo copy. Refresh retains the language through its URL and resets playback.
languages.chineseCapture: node scripts/capture-chinese.cjs then python scripts/encode-demos.py --zh. Real Chinese UI, Chinese filenames, tags, Markdown text and an embedded-font Chinese PDF fixture. Isolated QA library only.
